source_of_claim: User-supplied cosine-label derivation and the existing BranchForgetting.inc definitions; formalized and compiled locally.
conditions: General candidate equality: natural d > 0, 0 <= t <= pi, labels in Fin d.
Real inverse counts: arbitrary natural n, y in (-1,1), or y = 1 / -1. n=0 is the identity.
The counted set consists of distinct real solutions, not labels or polynomial multiplicities.
excluded: A base-three encoding of branch words
Identification with a separate K,S,C transition system

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.candidate
declarations.source_declaration_header: def candidate (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (j : Fin d) : ℝ

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.candidateSet
declarations.source_declaration_header: def candidateSet (d : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : Finset ℝ

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.cos_eq_on_turn
LinearInputBranchFibers.candidate_angle_bounds
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem candidate_angle_bounds {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) {t : ℝ}
    (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (htπ : t ≤ π) (j : Fin d) :
    0 ≤ (t + (j : ℝ) * (2 * π)) / d ∧
      (t + (j : ℝ) * (2 * π)) / d < 2 * π

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.candidate_eq_iff
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem candidate_eq_iff {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) {t : ℝ}
    (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (htπ : t ≤ π) (j k : Fin d) :
    candidate d t j = candidate d t k ↔
      j = k ∨ t + ((j : ℝ) + (k : ℝ)) * π = d * π

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.candidate_injective_regular
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem candidate_injective_regular {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) {t : ℝ}
    (ht0 : 0 < t) (htπ : t < π) : Function.Injective (candidate d t)

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.candidate_eq_zero_iff
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem candidate_eq_zero_iff {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (j k : Fin d) :
    candidate d 0 j = candidate d 0 k ↔ j = k ∨ (j : ℕ) + k = d

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.candidate_eq_pi_iff
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem candidate_eq_pi_iff {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (j k : Fin d) :
    candidate d π j = candidate d π k ↔ j = k ∨ (j : ℕ) + k + 1 = d

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.candidateSet_card_regular
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem candidateSet_card_regular {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) {t : ℝ}
    (ht0 : 0 < t) (htπ : t < π) : (candidateSet d t).card = d

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.lowLabel
declarations.source_declaration_header: def lowLabel (m : ℕ) (j : Fin (m + 1)) : Fin (2 * m + 1)

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.zeroRepresentative
declarations.source_declaration_header: def zeroRepresentative (m : ℕ) (j : Fin (2 * m + 1)) : Fin (m + 1)

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.piRepresentative
declarations.source_declaration_header: def piRepresentative (m : ℕ) (j : Fin (2 * m + 1)) : Fin (m + 1)

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.zeroRepresentative_lowLabel
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem zeroRepresentative_lowLabel (m : ℕ) (j : Fin (m + 1)) :
    zeroRepresentative m (lowLabel m j) = j

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.piRepresentative_lowLabel
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem piRepresentative_lowLabel (m : ℕ) (j : Fin (m + 1)) :
    piRepresentative m (lowLabel m j) = j

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.candidate_zero_representative
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem candidate_zero_representative (m : ℕ) (j : Fin (2 * m + 1)) :
    candidate (2 * m + 1) 0 (lowLabel m (zeroRepresentative m j)) =
      candidate (2 * m + 1) 0 j

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.candidate_pi_representative
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem candidate_pi_representative (m : ℕ) (j : Fin (2 * m + 1)) :
    candidate (2 * m + 1) π (lowLabel m (piRepresentative m j)) =
      candidate (2 * m + 1) π j

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.candidate_zero_low_injective
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem candidate_zero_low_injective (m : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (fun j : Fin (m + 1) => candidate (2 * m + 1) 0 (lowLabel m j))

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.candidate_pi_low_injective
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem candidate_pi_low_injective (m : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (fun j : Fin (m + 1) => candidate (2 * m + 1) π (lowLabel m j))

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.candidateSet_zero_image
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem candidateSet_zero_image (m : ℕ) :
    candidateSet (2 * m + 1) 0 =
      Finset.univ.image (fun j : Fin (m + 1) => candidate (2 * m + 1) 0 (lowLabel m j))

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.candidateSet_pi_image
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem candidateSet_pi_image (m : ℕ) :
    candidateSet (2 * m + 1) π =
      Finset.univ.image (fun j : Fin (m + 1) => candidate (2 * m + 1) π (lowLabel m j))

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.candidateSet_zero_card
declarations.source_declaration_header: theorem candidateSet_zero_card (m : ℕ) : (candidateSet (2 * m + 1) 0).card = m + 1

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.candidateSet_pi_card
declarations.source_declaration_header: theorem candidateSet_pi_card (m : ℕ) : (candidateSet (2 * m + 1) π).card = m + 1

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.zero_retraction_idempotent
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem zero_retraction_idempotent (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ j, lowLabel m (zeroRepresentative m (lowLabel m (zeroRepresentative m j))) =
      lowLabel m (zeroRepresentative m j)

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.pi_retraction_idempotent
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem pi_retraction_idempotent (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ j, lowLabel m (piRepresentative m (lowLabel m (piRepresentative m j))) =
      lowLabel m (piRepresentative m j)

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.three_pow_odd_form
declarations.source_declaration_header: theorem three_pow_odd_form (n : ℕ) : 3 ^ n = 2 * (3 ^ n / 2) + 1

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.ternary_candidates_regular_card
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem ternary_candidates_regular_card (n : ℕ) {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 < t) (htπ : t < π) :
    (candidateSet (3 ^ n) t).card = 3 ^ n

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.ternary_candidates_zero_card
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem ternary_candidates_zero_card (n : ℕ) :
    (candidateSet (3 ^ n) 0).card = (3 ^ n + 1) / 2

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.ternary_candidates_pi_card
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem ternary_candidates_pi_card (n : ℕ) :
    (candidateSet (3 ^ n) π).card = (3 ^ n + 1) / 2

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.cosine_solution_has_label
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem cosine_solution_has_label {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) {a t : ℝ}
    (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (haπ : a ≤ π) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (htπ : t ≤ π)
    (h : cos ((d : ℝ) * a) = cos t) :
    ∃ j : Fin d, candidate d t j = cos a

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.chebyshev_gt_one
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem chebyshev_gt_one {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) :
    1 < LinearInputBranchForgetting.chebyshevThree x

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.ternaryIterate_gt_one
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem ternaryIterate_gt_one (n : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) :
    1 < LinearInputBranchForgetting.ternaryIterate n x

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.ternaryIterate_neg
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem ternaryIterate_neg (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    LinearInputBranchForgetting.ternaryIterate n (-x) =
      -LinearInputBranchForgetting.ternaryIterate n x

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.ternary_inverse_mem_interval
LinearInputBranchFibers.ternary_inverse_iff_candidate
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem ternary_inverse_iff_candidate (n : ℕ) {t : ℝ}
    (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (htπ : t ≤ π) (x : ℝ) :
    LinearInputBranchForgetting.ternaryIterate n x = cos t ↔
      x ∈ candidateSet (3 ^ n) t

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.real_inverse_card_regular
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem real_inverse_card_regular (n : ℕ) {y : ℝ} (hy0 : -1 < y) (hy1 : y < 1) :
    {x : ℝ | LinearInputBranchForgetting.ternaryIterate n x = y}.ncard = 3 ^ n

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.real_inverse_card_one
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem real_inverse_card_one (n : ℕ) :
    {x : ℝ | LinearInputBranchForgetting.ternaryIterate n x = 1}.ncard = (3 ^ n + 1) / 2

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.real_inverse_card_neg_one
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem real_inverse_card_neg_one (n : ℕ) :
    {x : ℝ | LinearInputBranchForgetting.ternaryIterate n x = -1}.ncard = (3 ^ n + 1) / 2

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.critical_depth_two_not_binary
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem critical_depth_two_not_binary :
    {x : ℝ | LinearInputBranchForgetting.ternaryIterate 2 x = 1}.ncard ≠ 2 ^ 2

declarations.source_declaration_header: def zeroPartner (m : ℕ) (j : Fin (2 * m + 1)) : Fin (2 * m + 1)

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.piPartner

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.zeroPartner_fixed_iff
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem zeroPartner_fixed_iff (m : ℕ) (j : Fin (2 * m + 1)) :
    zeroPartner m j = j ↔ (j : ℕ) = 0

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.piPartner_fixed_iff
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem piPartner_fixed_iff (m : ℕ) (j : Fin (2 * m + 1)) :
    piPartner m j = j ↔ (j : ℕ) = m

LinearInputBranchFibers.pi_fiber_pair
LinearInputBranchFibers.zero_fiber_card
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem zero_fiber_card (m : ℕ) (j : Fin (2 * m + 1)) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun k => candidate (2 * m + 1) 0 k = candidate (2 * m + 1) 0 j)).card =
      if (j : ℕ) = 0 then 1 else 2

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.pi_fiber_card
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem pi_fiber_card (m : ℕ) (j : Fin (2 * m + 1)) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun k => candidate (2 * m + 1) π k = candidate (2 * m + 1) π j)).card =
      if (j : ℕ) = m then 1 else 2

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchFibers.critical_candidate_collision
declarations.source_declaration_header:
theorem critical_candidate_collision :
    candidate 3 0 ⟨1, by decide⟩ = candidate 3 0 ⟨2, by decide⟩
